If you're here, then you know the state of /r/playrust. It is overrun with suggestions that have been made before, and lots and lots of user videos of raids. My hope for this new community is to be open, friendly and helpful. It is up to us to control the content, and I think Voat's CCP rules will be much more useful in this community because it is so naturally hostile. Most of us bring our KoS mentality with us, but I'm asking you to leave that behind. Let's make this subverse just a little better. Newman's rejoice! We have a new home!
I'm down for another Rust home, but what is it you want? Do you not want people posting links to their let's plays or videos? Do you not want suggestions?

It's not that I don't want these things to be posted, they just should not be on the front page in my opinion. There is constantly patch notes and dev previews available, and I think these are more important to the average user. The old community was full of clueless players upvoting and downvoting for seemingly no reason .And there is no excuse for a suggestion that is already in the road map to make it on the front page, which happened quite often. I just want people to be more informed, the information is all available.

This post is a suggestion in itself, I am not trying to set any rules or anything.
Perhaps we should have a sticky that is the latest Dev update? That way people don't have to compete to get the Dev update to the front page.
